question: Which among the following lakes lies on the borders of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pulicat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pulicat Lake **(also known as **Pulicat Lagoon**) lies on the borders of **Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Pulicat Lake is the **second-largest brackish water lagoon **in India.
 
• It spans the states of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, with the **majority of its area falling in Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The lake is separated from the Bay of Bengal by a barrier island known as **Sriharikota.**
 
• Pulicat Lake is home to a **rich variety of flora and fauna**, including numerous **bird species**, making it an important bird sanctuary and an ecologically significant area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dal Lake:**

 
 
• Dal Lake is a popular tourist attraction located in **Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty, serene surroundings, and floating gardens called** "Rad" and "Sankara."**
 
• The lake is surrounded by **snow-capped mountains, Mughal gardens, and charming houseboats.**
 
• **Shikaras,** traditional wooden boats, are commonly used for transportation and sightseeing on Dal Lake.
 
 
 
• **Loktak Lake:**
 
 
• Loktak Lake is the** largest freshwater lake in Northeast India,** situated in **Manipur.**
 
• It is known for its **floating phumdis** (heterogeneous mass of vegetation, soil, and organic matter) that can be seen on the lake's surface.
 
• The lake is home to the **Keibul Lamjao National Park,** which is the **world's only floating national park** and a refuge for the endangered Manipur **brow-antlered deer.**
 
• Loktak Lake plays a crucial role in maintaining the ecological balance and is a significant source of livelihood for the local communities.
 
 
 
• **Sambhar Lake:**
 
 
• Sambhar Lake, located in** Rajasthan**, is the** largest inland saltwater lake in India.**
 
• It is an important wintering area for migratory** birds, including flamingos**, and is recognized as a **Ramsar site.**
 
• Sambhar Lake is known for its **salt production**, and** salt pans **can be seen around the lake's vicinity.
 
• The lake is surrounded by** vast saline wetlands,** giving it a unique landscape and attracting **nature enthusiasts and birdwatchers.**
